appearances.title: MiniMax publishes open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B MoE with 23B active
appearances.summary: The M3.1 Flash weights promised at its Oct 19 API launch are now on Hugging Face and ModelScope, so builders can self-host a 428B-total, 23B-active agentic coding model with sparse attention and DSpark speculative decoding. SGLang, TokenSpeed, NVIDIA and AMD shipped day-0 serving support.
